ns2:course.label: Democratization
ns2:course.description: Examines the global process of democratization, with special attention to gains and failures in selected areas since 1974. Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
